target: AArch64 native ZealC under UTM-bundled QEMU/HVF, one vCPU, virtio-ramfb, VirtIO keyboard and tablet
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-psalmody-current-55719.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-psalmody
checks: Psalmody opened its editor and accepted note entry and playback input.
Shift+Escape returned to the graphical terminal; 40+2 evaluated to 42 and zstatus reported failed=0.
live_audio: User reports that Beep and Psalmody playback are audible in UTM with VirtIO Sound selected.
scope_note: Automated editor/playback input and shell-recovery check on the exact ISO, paired with the user's live audible confirmation. This does not accept every song-editing workflow.
